reviewed_paths: router/skirnir_router/browser_headers.py (unchanged, CSP applies to the new UI section)
summary: Router 0.35.0, ADR-0101: problems computed in a new module problems.py as records (fixed code, severity, node, subject, params, message) instead of German sentences built in ha.py. New: GET /admin/problems on the control port, gauges skirnir_problem{code,severity,node,subject} and skirnir_problems_active in /metrics, a problems list in the web UI overview, config key router.problem_language (de default, en; schema, example, EDITABLE choice). B2: the new route is registered on the control app only; basic_auth_middleware runs before it like for every /admin GET (traced; it is not under /v1/, so no token bypass); it is read-only, so the CSRF header does not apply; an unknown lang is a 400 value, not an exception. Tested rejected cases: no credentials 401, wrong password 401, bad lang 400. B3/TM-07: node names and model names reported by an approved agent and an agent's update message reach the records. Templates are filled once with str.format (a reported name with braces is not expanded again; tested). Free text (update message, version check error, GPU guard reason) stays in params and the message, never in a metric label (tested). Labels carry fixed codes, fixed severities, node names (registry/config), role and provider names (config) and model names the node reports (already labels of skirnir_model_loaded_gib, same bound). The Prometheus label escaping now also escapes a line feed, so a reported model name cannot start a new sample line (tested); this also hardens the existing model labels. TM-03: the UI builds the list with createElement/textContent only, no innerHTML or inline handler; checked in a browser with a node named 'evil' shown as text, no console errors; CSP unchanged. TM-15/B9: /metrics and /admin/problems expose no data that was not already visible to the same authenticated reader (/admin/ha has the same texts); no new log lines, no secrets. TM-08: compute() is the same pure view HA computes every interval (one scheduler pass over the roles with mutate=False, no breaker switching), now also per /metrics scrape and per /admin/problems GET, behind Basic Auth. The HA attribute keeps its exact German texts by default (tested byte for byte against the 0.34 sentences; end-to-end HA checks unchanged). The CI change only adds the new self-test to the explicit list. No dependency, workflow permission, review-policy or agent change. Public data: the added lines use synthetic names only (synth-*, gpu-desktop, loopback).

limitations: The CI python job on Linux and the PostgreSQL integrations were not run locally; the change touches no session, memory or storage code.
Texts an agent sends (GPU guard reason, update messages) remain in the agent's language and are passed through as before.
Model names reported by a compromised approved agent can still create label series (bounded by what the node reports, as for skirnir_model_loaded_gib); no new cap was added.
No Prometheus server or Alertmanager was run against the new gauge; the exposition lines were checked as text.
